fr.elements: Vehicle Parking Area; Detached Structure; Open Lawn Area; Sport Court
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance and any secondary access points with reflective address numbers visible from the street.
• Keep all access points to the detached structure clear of parked vehicles to allow responders to reach it directly.
• Keep the sport court area clear of stored equipment or vehicles that could block responder staging on that surface.
• Identify which access point provides the most direct route to the detached structure and mark it clearly for arriving responders.
• Keep the open lawn area free of stored items that could obstruct responder movement across the property.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing close to the house to create open space between the plants and the structure.
• Remove any dead or dry material from within shrub clusters near the house.
• Keep gaps between individual shrubs so fire cannot move easily from one to the next toward the structure.
• Clear shrubs away from around any outbuildings or detached structures on the property.
• Maintain open ground directly around the foundation of the house, free of shrub growth.
